result.raw_final:
Qatar Airways’ checked baggage allowance for economy class varies by route and fare. On routes using the weight system, economy fares typically include **20–35 kg**; routes using the piece system typically allow **2 pieces of up to 23 kg each**. Check the allowance for your specific trip, since exceptions apply.

Source: [Qatar Airways baggage allowance](https://www.qatarairways.com/en-us/baggage/allowance.html)

FINAL ANSWER: Economy checked baggage allowance varies by route and fare: typically 20–35 kg on weight-based routes, or 2 pieces up to 23 kg each on piece-based routes.
